steps.description: Minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), median-of-ratios size factors, design ~ condition with control as the explicit reference level, contrast condition treated vs control. DESeq2 Wald test, Cook's-distance outlier flagging left on (NA p-values reported separately). apeglm lfcShrink for the reported fold change. BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering; inspect the unadjusted p-value histogram before trusting adjusted values. Then run edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same filtered counts with TMM normalization as the robustness second method and report the overlap.

n_tested and n_de (padj < 0.05) reported; Cook's-distance NA genes counted separately
DESeq2 vs edgeR QL overlap reported: intersection as high-confidence set, single-method calls as secondary set

plan.title: Treated vs control DE with confounded batch, labelled
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw salmon-derived gene-level counts (12000 genes x 13 columns, 12 usable samples) from human lung, 6 treated vs 6 control, with processing batch perfectly confounded with condition (all controls in B1, all treated in B2). Per rule R-0005@668f the batch term cannot be fitted and no batch correction (ComBat-seq, removeBatchEffect, surrogate variables) is permitted — the model matrix is not full rank and any removal method would strip the condition effect along with the batch. The knowledge service returned match: flag with outcome confounded_label_or_stop; the user's question is whether genes differ, so the plan proceeds under the explicit assumption of no batch effect and labels every result as confounded, reporting the caveat prominently rather than repairing it. Because transcript-level quantifications are not staged (only a gene-level count CSV), tximport length offsets cannot be applied; this limitation is stated in the report. Pipeline: blind sample-structure QC (vst, PCA, distances, coloured by condition and by batch), minimal pre-filter, median-of-ratios normalization inside the DESeq2 model, explicit reference level, Wald test with apeglm shrinkage, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, plus an edgeR quasi-likelihood run as the robustness second method whose overlap with DESeq2 defines the high-confidence gene set (R-0042@54e1). Report carries MA and dispersion diagnostics, both shrunken and unshrunken log2FC, Cook's-distance NA accounting, p-value histogram, reproducibility record, and the confounded-design warning on every result table.
